chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But upon those who take him as a guardian.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardians/leaders

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority (hukm) is not absolute over all believers but is conditional upon their voluntary acceptance of him as a master or guide. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle that spiritual subjugation to Shaytan is a result of human choice rather than divine decree, reinforcing the concept of free will in the believer's journey.
